scale_basis: Fixed median over every accepted anchor, not generated outputs

conventions.edge_dilation: Euclidean native-pixel radius; applied identically to bodies and reflections
conventions.layer_occlusion: Overwrite transformed dilated support including its black interior; configured back-to-front order
conventions.reflection_pairing: User spatial rule, nearest horizontal center then vertical gap then role for multiple candidates
conventions.clipping: 1 - visible mask pixels / full offscreen-extended transformed mask pixels; NEAREST rasterization
conventions.affine: PIL inverse affine NEAREST, pixel-edge pivot bottom-center body/top-center reflection
conventions.overlay: Red scaled source, green accepted anchor; overlap mixed; review derivative
